title: 第20章 只能中午做早晚要完第21章 再见陈念
slug: 诸天之百味人生第一千六百二十章
content_zh:
第20章只能中午做，早晚要完
新书期数据很重要，看书的朋友记得收藏，另外求推荐票，求投资，拜谢了。
※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
“四眼，你还是我们兄弟呢，你哥真特么不够意思，一张证要两千块，他是穷疯了还是当咱们大头啊，他要不是你哥，我刚才就干他了！”
路边一家修理手机的店铺里，赖子咋咋呼呼对着一个四眼卷毛大呼小叫。
四眼卷毛也是觉得自己哥哥理亏，闷头抽着手里的香烟，默不作声。
“行了，多大点事儿啊，又不是四眼管咱们要这么多的，你说他有什么用！”
华十二坐在柜台里摆弄着店里的电脑，头也不抬的说了一句。
大康在一旁看着华十二操作电脑，疑惑的问道：“小北哥，你这是干嘛呢？”
他这么一问，赖子和四眼也好奇围过来观看，华十二瞥了一眼大康，无奈道：
“你整天上网，脑子里该不会除了魔兽世界，就是穿越火线吧，这叫ps是亚洲四大邪术之一，没钱弄假的，咱们就p一个好了！”
华十二熟练的将证件上的出生日期用ps技术修改成大了一岁，这样单看这张照片的话，他就是一个年满十八周岁的成年人了。
四眼倒是明白ps是什么，问道：“小北你弄这个干什么？”
“没什么，就是觉得自己年龄太小，p大一岁而已！”
华十二笑了笑，将这张p过的照片，通过数据线剪切粘贴到自己手里机，然后拿起手机朝四眼摆了摆手：
“有事先走了，我有个朋友的手机坏了，晚上过来找你！”
说完走出柜台，招呼赖子和大康离开了这里。
从四眼那里出来之后，华十二让大康和赖子最近小心些，最好躲起来别露头，省得马七拿他没办法，找两人出气。
赖子和大康都点头答应，问华十二什么时候开工。
开工指的就是盗窃和收账，华十二成了刘北山之后，洗白上岸还来不及，哪能再做这种事情，当即告诉两人自己以后都不做了。

同时他语重心长的和两人说道：
“咱们做的这些事都是见不得光的，这种事只能中午做，早晚会出事，咱们仨才多大，总不能一辈子做这个吧？”
“现在仗着未成年这层保护伞，小偷小摸，打架斗殴，即便被抓了，顶多教育一番就被放出来了，可以后呢？我下半年就满十八了，你们两个也快了吧？”
华十二这番话一说，大康和赖子都愣住了，显然他们之前过的都是乐呵一天算一天的日子，从来没想过这么远的问题。
大康沉默了一会，这才问道：“那小北哥你以后打算干什么？”
华十二拍了拍大康和赖子的肩膀：
“咱们以后的事情我有计划，你们安心等着就行了，记住这两天不要出来浪！”
见两人都点了点头，华十二这才与两人再见，让他们等自己电话，然后拦了一辆出租车，回刘北山家里去了。
回到了刘北山的家，华十二用手机下载了一款某易的彩票app。

"Siyan, you are still our brother. Your brother is really unworthy. A certificate costs two thousand yuan. Is he so poor that he thinks he is our boss? If he hadn't been your brother, I would have fucked him just now!"
In a mobile phone repair shop on the roadside, Lai Zi yelled at a curly guy with four eyes.
Four-eyed curly hair also felt that his brother was in the wrong, so he smoked the cigarette in his hand and remained silent.
"Okay, what a big deal, it's not the Four-Eyed Manager that we need so much, what use do you think he has!"
Hua Twelve sat at the counter, playing with the computer in the store, and said something without raising his head.
Dakang watched Hua Twelve operate the computer and asked doubtfully: "Brother Xiao Bei, what are you doing?"
When he asked, Lai Zi and Si Yan came over to watch out of curiosity. Hua Twelve glanced at Dakang and said helplessly:
"You surf the Internet all day long, and besides World of Warcraft, you probably have CrossFire in your mind. It's called PS and it's one of the four major evil arts in Asia. If you don't have money to make a fake one, let's just create one!"
Hua Twelve skillfully changed the date of birth on the document to be one year older using Photoshop technology. In this way, just looking at this photo, he is an adult who is over 18 years old.
Si Yan understood what PS was and asked, "Xiao Bei, what are you doing with this?"
"It's nothing, I just feel like I'm too young, I'm just one year older!"
Hua Twelve smiled, cut and pasted the edited photo into his phone through the data cable, then picked up the phone and waved to Siyan:
"Let's go now. One of my friends' cell phones is broken. I'll come over to you tonight!"
After speaking, he walked out of the counter, greeted Lai Zi and Dakang and left.
After coming out of the Four Eyes, Hua Twelve told Dakang and Lai Zi to be more careful recently, and it was best to hide and not show their heads, so that Ma Qi would not be able to do anything to him and take it out on the two of them.
Lai Zi and Dakang both nodded in agreement and asked Hua Twelve when work would start.
Starting work refers to stealing and collecting accounts. After Hua Twelve became Liu Beishan, it was too late to clear his name and go ashore. How could he do such a thing again? He immediately told the two of them that he would never do it again.
At the same time, he said to the two of them seriously:
"The things we do are all shady. We can only do this kind of thing at noon. Sooner or later something will happen. How old are the three of us? We can't do this for the rest of our lives, right?"
"Now, relying on the protection of being a minor, if you commit petty theft or get into fights, even if you are caught, you can at most be released after some education. What can I do later? I will be eighteen in the second half of the year. You two will be soon, right?"
When Hua Twelve said these words, Dakang and Lai Zi were both stunned. It was obvious that they had lived happily day by day and had never thought about such a far-reaching problem.
Dakang was silent for a while, and then asked: "Brother Bei, what are you planning to do in the future?"
Hua Twelve patted Dakang and Lai Zi on the shoulders:
"I have plans for our future affairs. Just wait and see. Remember not to wander around in these two days!"
Seeing that both of them nodded, Hua Twelve said goodbye to them and asked them to wait for his call. Then he hailed a taxi and went back to Liu Beishan's home.
Back at Liu Beishan's home, Hua Twelve downloaded a lottery app from Yiyi on his mobile phone.
